verdict.rationale: Floot has a dedicated self-hosting page stating that you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like. Other docs confirm the project is a real TypeScript/React app that can be fully exported, and that a full SQL dump of the database can be downloaded on any plan. missing for 10: step-by-step self-hosting docs (supported hosts, runtime requirements, how Floot-brokered services like OAuth, email and scheduled jobs work off-platform), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful external deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure

citations.quote: you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like.
A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
You can download a full SQL dump of your database at any time, on any plan
